title: himmel health
description: Is himmel healthy, what is failing and what to do. HIMMEL-4292.

panels.title: Is himmel healthy?
panels.description: The worst firing alert decides: Act now (a page alert, or the flow exporter is down or missing, so alerts cannot be trusted), Needs a look (a warn alert), or All clear. No data means Prometheus is not answering, so nothing below is current.

targets.expr: max((2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="page"}) or (ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warn"}) or (2 * (up{job="flow-exporter"} == bool 0)) or (2 * absent(up{job="flow-exporter"})) or vector(0))

defaults.noValue: No data: Prometheus is not answering

panels.title: What needs attention
panels.description: Every firing alert, with what to do. An alert this dashboard has no advice for shows its raw name.

HimmelFlowRunError.text: HimmelFlowRunError — A scheduled job failed. Open its run log and re-run it.

HimmelFlowRunTruncated.text: HimmelFlowRunTruncated — A scheduled job stopped early. Check its run log; it usually hit a time or quota limit.

HimmelFlowRunStalled.text: HimmelFlowRunStalled — A scheduled job is stuck. Check it is still running; kill and re-arm it if not.

HimmelFlowLastSuccessAgeExceeded.text: HimmelFlowLastSuccessAgeExceeded — A scheduled job has not succeeded in over twice its interval. Check that its cron line is still there.

HimmelQuietRunOrphans.text: HimmelQuietRunOrphans — Test runs were left behind by a closed session. Stop them.

HimmelWatcherDown.text: HimmelWatcherDown — Monitoring itself is down. Restart the observability stack.

HimmelLunaInboxBacklogRising.text: HimmelLunaInboxBacklogRising — The Luna inbox has grown for 3 days. Run the clip ingest.

HimmelSessionDead.text: HimmelSessionDead — A Claude session crashed without closing. Check its handover and resume it.

HimmelHookChainBudgetPressure.text: HimmelHookChainBudgetPressure — Guardrails are timing out. Too many sessions at once; close some.

HimmelHookChainBudgetDenials.text: HimmelHookChainBudgetDenials — Guardrails are refusing commands because they time out. Close sessions now.

HimmelHookChainLogUnreadable.text: HimmelHookChainLogUnreadable — The guardrail timeout log cannot be read, so the timeout count may be low. Check file permissions.

HimmelScheduledTaskDisabled.text: HimmelScheduledTaskDisabled — Windows: a scheduled task is disabled. Re-enable it in Task Scheduler.

HimmelAgentTreeRamRunaway.text: HimmelAgentTreeRamRunaway — Windows: agent processes are using too much memory. Close idle sessions.

HimmelOrphanProcesses.text: HimmelOrphanProcesses — Windows: processes were left behind by closed sessions. Stop them.

HimmelKernelPoolHigh.text: HimmelKernelPoolHigh — Windows: kernel memory pool is high. Plan a reboot.

HimmelKernelPoolCritical.text: HimmelKernelPoolCritical — Windows: kernel memory pool is critical. Reboot soon.

HimmelKernelPoolLeakRate.text: HimmelKernelPoolLeakRate — Windows: kernel memory pool is leaking. Plan a reboot.

HimmelCommitPressure.text: HimmelCommitPressure — Windows: committed memory is near the limit. Close programs or reboot.

Late = more than one interval since the last success; Overdue = more than two (the HimmelFlowLastSuccessAgeExceeded line). Failures count errored, truncated, stalled and abandoned runs in the 14-day ledger window.

options.content:
These health answers have no Prometheus series yet, so this dashboard leaves them out instead of faking them.

- **Daily health check** (himmel-doctor results) — shown via `/obs-report`, HIMMEL-4291.
- **Machine setup** (`himmelctl status`) — shown via `/obs-report`, HIMMEL-4291.
- **qmd search index age** — shown via `/obs-report`, HIMMEL-4291.
- **Console legs and their cost** — machine-readable after HIMMEL-4290; shown via `/obs-report`, HIMMEL-4291.
- **Usage bank reset time** — the exporter does not keep `resets_at` yet.
- **Advice per alert** lives in this dashboard's mapping, not in the alert rules.

Windows-only series (scheduled tasks, agent memory, kernel pool) are not charted here; `war-room-system.json` keeps them.
